decisionsTitle: «Ce îi spui»: the sentence a volunteer tells a person who asks where their registration stands, per state, in the person's language
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-02:** «trebuie să avem mereu portițe și scurtături din back-office, oamenii mai pierd mailuri, le mai intră în SPAM». Approved for the small batch on 2026-10-03 (`docs/QUEUE.md` «Later»: «Ce îi spui»).

**What happened until now.** Somebody who asks the club where their registration stands — on the phone, by message, at a table before race day — got whatever the staff member made of the state chip («Așteaptă declarația», «Pe lista de așteptare»). The person had read sentences of their own on their page, in «Toate înscrierile mele» and in the emails (§619, §629, §634); the staff member had a chip and a timeline. Two people could tell the same person two stories.

**Decision.** One server-rendered block on the registration's page (`/admin/registrations/<id>`), under the state and above the verbs: «Ce îi spui» / “What to tell them”, with one line of help — «Propoziția pe care i-o spui cuiva care întreabă unde e înscrierea lui; aceleași cuvinte pe care le-a citit și el.» — the sentences, and «Copiază» / “Copy”, which puts them on the clipboard for a message (the members' codes' copy button, §552; without JavaScript the lines are there to select).
- **In the registration's language**, whatever the staff member reads the page in: the lines carry `lang`, and a small caption says which language when it is not the reader's («În engleză, limba în care s-a înscris.»). `ui/tell-words.ts#whatToTell` resolves the two catalogues outside the request's locale, as `promo-consent-words.ts` does.
- **The participant's own words wherever they exist, read from the same keys, never copied:** the state as «Toate înscrierile mele» names it (`Registrations.mine.status.*`, framed «Înscrierea ta: …»); a held place's deadline as `mine.confirmBy` («Confirmă semnând declarația, din emailul de înscriere, până …»), with `confirmationDueMoment`'s «la start»; a family's reservation as `mine.reservedUntil`; the waiting line through `waitlistStandingPhrase` itself (§629, §634: a position only with automatic offers and the count public, never otherwise); a cancelled event as `manage.eventCancelled`, and nothing else then — a cancellation voids every deadline (§331); the spam hint (`spamHint.body`) on a state whose next step is a link in an email (an address to confirm, a declaration to sign, an offer to accept), and not once that link or offer has lapsed.
- **The rest in the backoffice's catalogue, worded to the person** (`Admin.registrations.tell.*`, both languages, each under 200 characters, §511): the address not confirmed («Apasă butonul din emailul primit de la noi…; până atunci nu îți ținem niciun loc.») or its link lapsed; a hold past its deadline, still kept (§160); an offer with its deadline, or lapsed; an offer whose first email is still queued — «emailul cu oferta e pe drum», no instant, since the send re-bases the deadline (§520), and no spam hint before any email has left; confirmed, with where the QR code is and the race number; expired.
- **One story with the public words and the emails, held by a test.** Where a public page or an email already says the thing, the line is that text: a check-in is `manage.selfCheckInDone`, read from the key; a cancelled row is `mine.cancelledTitle` and the first sentence of `mine.cancelled` («Înscrierea a fost anulată. Locul tău a fost eliberat.» — not that page's second sentence, which is about the link just spent); a lapsed declaration hold is the `DECLARATION_HOLD_EXPIRED` email's sentence without the event's name («Locul tău a expirat: declarația nu a fost semnată la timp.», §638). A unit test keeps each equal to its counterpart. A lapsed offer has no email to match — its lapse is silent and the row expires off the waiting list (§331, `never-queued.ts`) — so its line says only that the place is no longer held, never that the person still waits.
- **The deadline** is `rowDeadlineOf`'s (§651): one helper for the list's «Până când», the timeline and this block, so an offer whose first email is still queued is open here too (§520).
- **«Linkul din email e valabil până {instant}.»** — the link the row's state waits on, chosen by purpose: `VERIFY_REGISTRATION_EMAIL` on `PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION`, `COMPLETE_DECLARATION` on `PENDING_DECLARATION`, `WAITLIST_OFFER` on `WAITLIST_OFFERED`, and no line on any other state; unused, not superseded or revoked, still ahead; the newest of that purpose, ties broken on `id`. Never the newest link of any purpose: `render.ts` mints the fourteen-day «Nu mai pot veni» link (`MANAGE_REGISTRATION`, §547) in the same send as each of those emails, at the same `now`, and every later message mints a newer one — the review found the block telling somebody whose offer lapsed the next day that their link lived two weeks. Not the public list's switch nor the form for another person on the address either. «până {instant}», not «până la …»: the instant carries its own «la» before the hour (§452, §651).

**No new round trip.** Everything the block says comes from the page's existing registration query (`findRegistrationDetailForAdmin`): the event's time zone, whether it is cancelled, its two waiting-list settings, the row's place and the line's length — written as the count of the `WAITLISTED` rows at or ahead of `(waitlisted_at, id)`, `readWaitlistPosition`'s own order, inside a `CASE` so a row that is not waiting costs nothing, and null on a cancelled event as that reader is — and the expiry of the live link the state waits on, one probe on `email_action_tokens_registration_purpose_expiry_idx`. A test holds the place and the length equal to `readWaitlistPosition`'s.

**Who reads it.** Every role that reads the page — the Administrator and the Organizer (§289). It says no address and nobody else's data: the line's numbers only, as the person reads them. The race-day desk is untouched: it shows every role a name, a state and a number (§67, `AGENTS.md` §15.11). The backoffice's words never reach a public page; the public words are read, not changed. The guide gains the task «Ce îi spui cuiva care întreabă» / “What to tell someone who asks” in «Participantul — pașii lui, și cum îi testezi», next to «Nu a primit emailul», which every role reads, and one step in the Organizer's «Vezi cine s-a înscris». `AGENTS.md` §15.11 says the block is none of the seven corrections and reads nothing beyond the page's query, stores nothing, carries no address and no link; `BUSINESS.md` BR-BUS-037 names it among what the backoffice shows for each registration.

*Rejected:*
- **The same block on the desk.** The desk is the race-day table, where every hold, offer and link is decided (§651's reasoning), and the Tehnic role reads it too.
- **A second copy of the participant's sentences in a domain helper.** Two copies drift; the block reads the participant's keys and `waitlistStandingPhrase` directly.
- **A position whatever the event's settings.** §629 and §634 decided when a waiting person is told a position; a staff member telling it on the phone would tell what the page hides.
- **A separate query for the line or the token.** The page's own query carries both.
- **A free-text template per event, written by the organizers.** A second set of words beside the participant's own drifts from them and from the emails at the first edit; the block reads the keys the person read, so one change moves both.
- **The action link itself in the block.** A link is the participant's whole proof of identity (`AGENTS.md` §12.8: hashed at rest, its secret only in the email sent); a link copied from a backoffice page into a message would make the staff member a carrier of it, to whoever asked. The block says until when the link lives; a new one goes by email, with «Retrimite emailul».
- **An address, on the block or at the desk.** The person who asks is not proven to be the person registered; the block says nothing they could not read on their own page, and the desk shows every role a name, a state and a number, never an address (§67).

**Consequences.** `registrations/admin-repository.ts` (`findRegistrationDetailForAdmin`: `eventTimezone`, `eventCancelled`, `waitlistAutoOffer`, `waitlistCountPublic`, `waitlistPosition`, `waitlistLength`, `liveLinkExpiresAt`); `registrations/ui/tell-words.ts` and `ui/WhatToTell.tsx` (new); the registration's page; `messages/{ro,en}.json` (`Admin.registrations.tell.*`, one guide task and one guide step). No migration, no dependency, no change to the allocator, the emails or a public page. `AGENTS.md` §15.11, `BUSINESS.md` BR-BUS-037. Tests: `unit/registrations/what-to-tell-words.test.ts` (each state, and the lines kept equal to their public and email counterparts), `integration/registrations/what-to-tell.test.ts` (the page's query; the link the state waits on with a manage link minted at the same instant and after; every state on the page, both waiting-list modes and the private count, a cancelled event, a special guest, for the Administrator and the Organizer, read in both languages, with no address and no link in the markup) — both new.
changelogLine: - **«Ce îi spui» on a registration's page** — the sentences to tell somebody who asks where their registration stands, the same words they read, in their language, with the email link's expiry, the spam hint and a «Copiază» button. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the registration's backoffice page, when the Administrator or the Organizer opens it, then under the state and above the verbs a block «Ce îi spui» / «What to tell them» says, in the registration's language (a caption names it when it differs from the reader's), the state as the participant's own page names it and that page's own sentence for it — the declaration's deadline, a family's reservation, the waiting line under the event's settings, a check-in, a cancelled event alone — and, where a public page or an email already words the thing, those words; the expiry of the live link the state waits on (the address's, the declaration's or the offer's, never the «Nu mai pot veni» link), the spam hint while a link in an email is the next step and has left, and no address and no link; every line under 200 characters in both languages, all from the page's existing query (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Ce îi spui»: what to tell a person who asks where their registration stands
